    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT week_end_date
        FROM data_867
        WHERE valid_order = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT week_end_date
        FROM data_867_pap
        WHERE valid_order = 1
          AND transaction_type = 'COM'
    ) m
),
commercial_demand_union_cte AS (
    SELECT
        transaction_date,
        week_end_date,
        qty_sold,
        is_business_day
    FROM data_867
    WHERE valid_order = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        transaction_date,
        week_end_date,
        qty_sold,
        is_business_day
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND transaction_type = 'COM'
),
rolling_52_weeks_cte AS (
    SELECT
        c.transaction_date,
        c.week_end_date,
        c.qty_sold,
        c.is_business_day
    FROM commercial_demand_union_cte c
    CROSS JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
    WHERE c.week_end_date >= DATEADD(WEEK, -51, m.max_week_end_date)
      AND c.week_end_date <= m.max_week_end_date
),
national_business_days_cte AS (
    SELECT
        week_end_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_business_day = 1 THEN transaction_date END) AS business_days
    FROM rolling_52_weeks_cte
    GROUP BY week_end_date
),
weekly_trend_cte AS (
    SELECT
        r.week_end_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, r.week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
        n.business_days,
        SUM(r.qty_sold) AS weekly_demand_vials_r52w,
        ROUND(SUM(r.qty_sold) / NULLIF(n.business_days, 0), 1) AS weekly_daily_average_demand_vials
    FROM rolling_52_weeks_cte r
    INNER JOIN national_business_days_cte n
        ON r.week_end_date = n.week_end_date
    GROUP BY
        r.week_end_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, r.week_end_date),
        n.business_days
)
SELECT
    week_start_date,
    week_end_date,
    business_days,
    weekly_demand_vials_r52w,
    weekly_daily_average_demand_vials
FROM weekly_trend_cte
ORDER BY week_end_date ASC;

        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867_pap
    ) d
),
current_quarter_cte AS (
    SELECT
        q.quarter_year,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', m.max_week_end_date) AS quarter_start_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(QUARTER, 1, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', m.max_week_end_date))) AS quarter_end_date,
        m.max_week_end_date
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte m
    JOIN (
        SELECT quarter_year, week_end_date
        FROM data_867
        UNION ALL
        SELECT quarter_year, week_end_date
        FROM data_867_pap
    ) q
        ON q.week_end_date = m.max_week_end_date
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q.quarter_year) = 1
),
period_completeness_cte AS (
    SELECT
        c.quarter_year,
        c.quarter_start_date,
        c.quarter_end_date,
        c.max_week_end_date,
        CASE WHEN c.max_week_end_date >= c.quarter_end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_current_quarter_complete
    FROM current_quarter_cte c
),
data_867_qtd_cte AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(d.qty_sold) AS demand_vials_qtd_data_867
    FROM data_867 d
    JOIN current_quarter_cte c

    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
),
data_867_pap_qtd_cte AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(d.qty_sold) AS demand_vials_qtd_data_867_pap
    FROM data_867_pap d

    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.transaction_type IN ('COM', 'PAP')
),
national_business_days_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_business_day = 1 THEN d.transaction_date END) AS business_days_qtd
    FROM (
        SELECT transaction_date, is_business_day, quarter_year, valid_order
        FROM data_867
        UNION ALL
        SELECT transaction_date, is_business_day, quarter_year, valid_order
        FROM data_867_pap
    ) d

),
final_metric_cte AS (

        p.quarter_end_date,
        p.max_week_end_date,
        p.is_current_quarter_complete,
        b.business_days_qtd,
        COALESCE(a.demand_vials_qtd_data_867, 0) + COALESCE(ap.demand_vials_qtd_data_867_pap, 0) AS demand_vials_qtd,
        ROUND(

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
  SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
  FROM data_867
),
current_period_cte AS (
  SELECT
    d.month_year AS current_month_year,
    d.quarter_year AS current_quarter_year,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', m.max_week_end_date) AS quarter_start_date,
    LAST_DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 2, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', m.max_week_end_date))) AS quarter_end_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', m.max_week_end_date) AS month_start_date,
    LAST_DAY(m.max_week_end_date) AS month_end_date,
    m.max_week_end_date
  FROM max_week_end_date_cte m
  JOIN data_867 d
    ON d.week_end_date = m.max_week_end_date
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.transaction_date DESC) = 1
),
business_days_elapsed_cte AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_business_day = 1 THEN d.transaction_date END) AS business_days_elapsed
  FROM data_867 d
  CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
  WHERE d.transaction_date BETWEEN cp.month_start_date AND cp.max_week_end_date
),
full_prior_months_budget_cte AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(f.budget), 0) AS prior_months_budget,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.number_of_business_days_month), 0) AS prior_months_business_days
  FROM forecast f
  CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
  WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM+PAP'
    AND f.quarter_year = cp.current_quarter_year
    AND f.month_year < cp.current_month_year
),
current_month_budget_cte AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(f.budget), 0) AS current_month_budget,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.number_of_business_days_month), 0) AS current_month_business_days
  FROM forecast f
  CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
  WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM+PAP'
    AND f.month_year = cp.current_month_year
),
qtd_budget_calc_cte AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      fp.prior_months_budget
      + (
          (cm.current_month_budget / NULLIF(cm.current_month_business_days, 0))
          * bde.business_days_elapsed
        ),
      0
    ) AS budget_vials_qtd
  FROM full_prior_months_budget_cte fp
  CROSS JOIN current_month_budget_cte cm
  CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_cte bde
),
qtd_business_days_cte AS (
  SELECT
    fp.prior_months_business_days + bde.business_days_elapsed AS business_days_qtd
  FROM full_prior_months_budget_cte fp
  CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_cte bde
)
SELECT
  cp.quarter_start_date,
  cp.quarter_end_date,
  cp.max_week_end_date,
  cp.current_quarter_year AS quarter_year,
  qbc.budget_vials_qtd,
  qbd.business_days_qtd
FROM current_period_cte cp
CROSS JOIN qtd_budget_calc_cte qbc
CROSS JOIN qtd_business_days_cte qbd
LIMIT 1;

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS as_of_date
    FROM data_867
),
current_period_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d.month_year AS current_month_year,
        d.quarter_year AS current_quarter_year,
        TO_DATE(CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(d.quarter_year, '-', 1), '-', LPAD(((CAST(RIGHT(d.quarter_year, 1) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1)::VARCHAR, 2, '0'), '-01')) AS period_start_date,
        LAST_DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 2, TO_DATE(CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(d.quarter_year, '-', 1), '-', LPAD(((CAST(RIGHT(d.quarter_year, 1) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1)::VARCHAR, 2, '0'), '-01')))) AS period_end_date,
        TO_DATE(CONCAT(d.month_year, '-01')) AS current_month_start_date,
        LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT(d.month_year, '-01'))) AS current_month_end_date
    FROM data_867 d
    INNER JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
        ON d.week_end_date = m.as_of_date
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.month_year, d.quarter_year) = 1
),
prior_months_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.budget), 0) AS prior_months_budget
    FROM forecast f
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND f.quarter_year = cp.current_quarter_year
      AND f.month_year < cp.current_month_year
),
current_month_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        f.budget,
        f.number_of_business_days_month,
        f.quarter_year,
        f.year
    FROM forecast f
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND f.month_year = cp.current_month_year
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.month_year) = 1
),
business_days_elapsed_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_business_day = 1
                              AND d.transaction_date BETWEEN cp.period_start_date AND m.as_of_date
                            THEN d.transaction_date END) AS qtd_business_days_elapsed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_business_day = 1
                              AND d.transaction_date BETWEEN cp.current_month_start_date AND m.as_of_date
                            THEN d.transaction_date END) AS mtd_business_days_elapsed
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    CROSS JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
),
mtd_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND((cmb.budget / NULLIF(cmb.number_of_business_days_month, 0)) * bde.mtd_business_days_elapsed, 0) AS mtd_budget
    FROM current_month_budget_cte cmb
    CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_cte bde
),
qtd_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(pmb.prior_months_budget + mb.mtd_budget, 0) AS budget_vials_qtd
    FROM prior_months_budget_cte pmb
    CROSS JOIN mtd_budget_cte mb
)
SELECT
    cp.current_quarter_year AS quarter_year,
    cp.period_start_date,
    cp.period_end_date,
    m.as_of_date,
    bde.qtd_business_days_elapsed AS business_days_elapsed,
    qb.budget_vials_qtd
FROM current_period_cte cp
CROSS JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_cte bde
CROSS JOIN qtd_budget_cte qb;

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM data_867
),
current_period_cte AS (
    SELECT
        m.max_week_end_date,
        YEAR(m.max_week_end_date) AS current_year,
        TO_CHAR(m.max_week_end_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS current_month_year,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', m.max_week_end_date) AS current_month_start_date,
        LAST_DAY(m.max_week_end_date) AS current_month_end_date,
        TO_DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(m.max_week_end_date), '-01-01')) AS year_start_date,
        TO_DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(m.max_week_end_date), '-12-31')) AS year_end_date
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte m
),
business_days_elapsed_current_month_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.transaction_date) AS business_days_elapsed_current_month
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
    WHERE d.is_business_day = 1
      AND d.transaction_date BETWEEN c.current_month_start_date AND c.max_week_end_date
),
business_days_elapsed_ytd_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.transaction_date) AS business_days_elapsed_ytd
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
    WHERE d.is_business_day = 1
      AND d.transaction_date BETWEEN c.year_start_date AND c.max_week_end_date
),
prior_months_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(f.budget), 0) AS prior_months_budget
    FROM forecast f
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
    WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND f.year = c.current_year
      AND f.month_year < c.current_month_year
),
current_month_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(f.budget), 0) AS current_month_budget,
        COALESCE(SUM(f.number_of_business_days_month), 0) AS number_of_business_days_month
    FROM forecast f
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
    WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND f.month_year = c.current_month_year
      AND f.year = c.current_year
),
ytd_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            p.prior_months_budget
            + (
                c.current_month_budget
                / NULLIF(c.number_of_business_days_month, 0)
              ) * b.business_days_elapsed_current_month
        )::INTEGER AS budget_vials_ytd
    FROM prior_months_budget_cte p
    CROSS JOIN current_month_budget_cte c
    CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_current_month_cte b
)
SELECT
    y.budget_vials_ytd,
    c.year_start_date,
    c.max_week_end_date,
    c.year_end_date,
    b.business_days_elapsed_ytd
FROM ytd_budget_cte y
CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_ytd_cte b;

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867
        UNION ALL
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867_pap
    ) w
),
current_period_cte AS (
    SELECT
        m.max_week_end_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', m.max_week_end_date) AS period_start_date,
        LAST_DAY(m.max_week_end_date) AS period_end_date,
        TO_VARCHAR(m.max_week_end_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_year
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte m
),
period_completeness_cte AS (
    SELECT
        c.month_year,
        c.period_start_date,
        c.period_end_date,
        c.max_week_end_date,
        CASE WHEN c.max_week_end_date >= c.period_end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_current_month_complete
    FROM current_period_cte c
),
actual_demand_867_cte AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.qty_sold), 0) AS demand_vials_mtd_data_867
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.transaction_date >= c.period_start_date
      AND d.transaction_date <= c.max_week_end_date
),
actual_demand_867_pap_cte AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.qty_sold), 0) AS demand_vials_mtd_data_867_pap
    FROM data_867_pap p
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
    WHERE p.valid_order = 1
      AND p.transaction_date >= c.period_start_date
      AND p.transaction_date <= c.max_week_end_date
),
actual_demand_total_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(a.demand_vials_mtd_data_867 + b.demand_vials_mtd_data_867_pap) AS demand_vials_mtd
    FROM actual_demand_867_cte a
    CROSS JOIN actual_demand_867_pap_cte b
),
business_days_elapsed_cte AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_date) AS business_days_elapsed_mtd
    FROM (
        SELECT d.transaction_date
        FROM data_867 d
        CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
        WHERE d.transaction_date >= c.period_start_date
          AND d.transaction_date <= c.max_week_end_date
          AND d.is_business_day = 1
        UNION
        SELECT p.transaction_date
        FROM data_867_pap p
        CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
        WHERE p.transaction_date >= c.period_start_date
          AND p.transaction_date <= c.max_week_end_date
          AND p.is_business_day = 1
    ) t
),
forecast_cte AS (
    SELECT
        f.month_year,
        ROUND(SUM(f.budget)) AS budget_vials_mtd_monthly_budget,
        MAX(f.number_of_business_days_month) AS number_of_business_days_month
    FROM forecast f
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte c
    WHERE f.month_year = c.month_year
      AND f.transaction_type = 'COM+PAP'
    GROUP BY f.month_year
),
budget_mtd_cte AS (
    SELECT
        f.month_year,
        f.number_of_business_days_month,
        ROUND((f.budget_vials_mtd_monthly_budget / NULLIF(f.number_of_business_days_month, 0)) * b.business_days_elapsed_mtd) AS budget_vials_mtd
    FROM forecast_cte f
    CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_cte b
),
daily_average_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(a.demand_vials_mtd / NULLIF(b.business_days_elapsed_mtd, 0), 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_mtd
    FROM actual_demand_total_cte a
    CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_cte b
),
attainment_cte AS (
    SELECT
        CONCAT(ROUND((a.demand_vials_mtd / NULLIF(b.budget_vials_mtd, 0)) * 100, 1), '%') AS attainment_pct_mtd_with_pap
    FROM actual_demand_total_cte a
    CROSS JOIN budget_mtd_cte b
)
SELECT
    pc.month_year,
    pc.period_start_date,
    pc.period_end_date,
    pc.max_week_end_date,
    pc.is_current_month_complete,
    bd.business_days_elapsed_mtd,
    bm.number_of_business_days_month,
    ad.demand_vials_mtd,
    da.daily_avg_demand_vials_mtd,
    bm.budget_vials_mtd,
    atn.attainment_pct_mtd_with_pap
FROM period_completeness_cte pc
CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_cte bd
CROSS JOIN actual_demand_total_cte ad
CROSS JOIN budget_mtd_cte bm
CROSS JOIN daily_average_cte da
CROSS JOIN attainment_cte atn;

subqueries.name: qtd_actual_total_cte

subqueries.logic: Add the summed budget for prior months in the current quarter to the rounded MTD forecast for the current month to produce budget_vials_qtd. Round the final QTD budget to the nearest integer.

subqueries.name: attainment_cte
subqueries.purpose: Calculate QTD attainment percentage
subqueries.logic: Compute attainment_pct_qtd as (demand_vials_qtd / budget_vials_qtd) * 100.

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM data_867
),
current_period_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d.quarter_year,
        d.month_year,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', m.max_week_end_date) AS period_start_date,
        LAST_DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, 2, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', m.max_week_end_date))) AS quarter_end_date,
        m.max_week_end_date
    FROM data_867 d
    INNER JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
        ON d.week_end_date = m.max_week_end_date
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.transaction_date DESC) = 1
),
qtd_actual_data_867_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(SUM(d.qty_sold), 0) AS demand_867_qtd
    FROM data_867 d
    INNER JOIN current_period_cte cp
        ON d.quarter_year = cp.quarter_year
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
),
qtd_actual_data_867_pap_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(SUM(p.qty_sold), 0) AS demand_867_pap_qtd
    FROM data_867_pap p
    INNER JOIN current_period_cte cp
        ON p.quarter_year = cp.quarter_year
    WHERE p.valid_order = 1
      AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
),
qtd_actual_total_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(COALESCE(a.demand_867_qtd, 0) + COALESCE(p.demand_867_pap_qtd, 0), 0) AS demand_vials_qtd
    FROM qtd_actual_data_867_cte a
    CROSS JOIN qtd_actual_data_867_pap_cte p
),
business_days_elapsed_current_month_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.transaction_date) AS business_days_elapsed_so_far
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    WHERE d.is_business_day = 1
      AND d.transaction_date >= TO_DATE(cp.month_year || '-01')
      AND d.transaction_date <= cp.max_week_end_date
),
current_month_forecast_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND((f.budget / NULLIF(f.number_of_business_days_month, 0)) * b.business_days_elapsed_so_far, 0) AS current_month_mtd_forecast
    FROM forecast f
    INNER JOIN current_period_cte cp
        ON f.month_year = cp.month_year
    CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_current_month_cte b
    WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM'
),
prior_months_in_quarter_forecast_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(f.budget), 0) AS prior_months_budget
    FROM forecast f
    INNER JOIN current_period_cte cp
        ON f.quarter_year = cp.quarter_year
    WHERE f.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND f.month_year < cp.month_year
),
qtd_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(COALESCE(p.prior_months_budget, 0) + COALESCE(c.current_month_mtd_forecast, 0), 0) AS budget_vials_qtd
    FROM prior_months_in_quarter_forecast_cte p
    CROSS JOIN current_month_forecast_cte c
),
business_days_qtd_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.transaction_date) AS business_days_qtd
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    WHERE d.is_business_day = 1
      AND d.transaction_date >= cp.period_start_date
      AND d.transaction_date <= cp.max_week_end_date
),
attainment_cte AS (
    SELECT
        CONCAT(ROUND((a.demand_vials_qtd / NULLIF(b.budget_vials_qtd, 0)) * 100, 1), '%') AS attainment_pct_qtd
    FROM qtd_actual_total_cte a
    CROSS JOIN qtd_budget_cte b
)
SELECT
    cp.quarter_year,
    cp.period_start_date AS period_start_date,
    cp.max_week_end_date AS period_end_date,
    cp.max_week_end_date,
    bd.business_days_qtd,
    a.demand_vials_qtd,
    b.budget_vials_qtd,
    atn.attainment_pct_qtd
FROM current_period_cte cp
CROSS JOIN business_days_qtd_cte bd
CROSS JOIN qtd_actual_total_cte a
CROSS JOIN qtd_budget_cte b
CROSS JOIN attainment_cte atn
LIMIT 1;

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT d.week_end_date
        FROM data_867 d
        WHERE d.valid_order = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT p.week_end_date
        FROM data_867_pap p
        WHERE p.valid_order = 1
          AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
    ) x
),
current_period_cte AS (
    SELECT
        m.max_week_end_date,
        YEAR(m.max_week_end_date) AS current_year,
        TO_CHAR(m.max_week_end_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS current_month_year,
        DATE_FROM_PARTS(YEAR(m.max_week_end_date), 1, 1) AS period_start_date,
        DATE_FROM_PARTS(YEAR(m.max_week_end_date), 12, 31) AS period_end_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', m.max_week_end_date) AS month_start_date,
        LAST_DAY(m.max_week_end_date, 'MONTH') AS month_end_date
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte m
),
business_days_elapsed_ytd_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.transaction_date) AS business_days_elapsed_ytd
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.year = cp.current_year
      AND d.is_business_day = 1
      AND d.transaction_date BETWEEN cp.period_start_date AND cp.max_week_end_date
),
business_days_elapsed_current_month_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.transaction_date) AS business_days_elapsed_current_month
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.year = cp.current_year
      AND d.is_business_day = 1
      AND d.transaction_date BETWEEN cp.month_start_date AND cp.max_week_end_date
),
forecast_completed_months_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(f.budget), 0) AS budget_vials_ytd_completed_months
    FROM forecast f
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    WHERE f.year = cp.current_year
      AND f.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND f.month_year < cp.current_month_year
),
forecast_current_month_mtd_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            (f.budget::FLOAT / NULLIF(f.number_of_business_days_month, 0)::FLOAT)
            * b.business_days_elapsed_current_month
        ) AS budget_vials_current_month_mtd
    FROM forecast f
    CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
    CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_current_month_cte b
    WHERE f.year = cp.current_year
      AND f.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND f.month_year = cp.current_month_year
),
ytd_budget_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            fc.budget_vials_ytd_completed_months
            + COALESCE(fm.budget_vials_current_month_mtd, 0)
        ) AS budget_vials_ytd
    FROM forecast_completed_months_cte fc
    LEFT JOIN forecast_current_month_mtd_cte fm ON 1 = 1
),
ytd_actual_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(d.actual_demand_data_867_ytd, 0)
            + COALESCE(p.actual_demand_data_867_pap_ytd, 0)
        ) AS demand_vials_ytd
    FROM (
        SELECT
            SUM(d.qty_sold) AS actual_demand_data_867_ytd
        FROM data_867 d
        CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
        WHERE d.valid_order = 1
          AND d.year = cp.current_year
    ) d
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
            SUM(p.qty_sold) AS actual_demand_data_867_pap_ytd
        FROM data_867_pap p
        CROSS JOIN current_period_cte cp
        WHERE p.valid_order = 1
          AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
          AND p.year = cp.current_year
    ) p
),
attainment_cte AS (
    SELECT
        cp.period_start_date,
        cp.period_end_date,
        cp.max_week_end_date,
        bytd.business_days_elapsed_ytd,
        ya.demand_vials_ytd,
        yb.budget_vials_ytd,
        CASE
            WHEN yb.budget_vials_ytd = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE CONCAT(ROUND((ya.demand_vials_ytd::FLOAT / NULLIF(yb.budget_vials_ytd, 0)::FLOAT) * 100, 1), '%')
        END AS attainment_pct_ytd
    FROM current_period_cte cp
    CROSS JOIN business_days_elapsed_ytd_cte bytd
    CROSS JOIN ytd_actual_cte ya
    CROSS JOIN ytd_budget_cte yb
)
SELECT
    period_start_date,
    period_end_date,
    max_week_end_date,
    business_days_elapsed_ytd,
    demand_vials_ytd,
    budget_vials_ytd,
    attainment_pct_ytd
FROM attainment_cte;

quarter_completeness_cte AS (

qtd_actual_data_867_cte AS (

qtd_actual_total_cte AS (

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867
        UNION ALL
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867_pap
    ) u
),
weekly_demand_867_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d.week_end_date,
        SUM(d.qty_sold) AS weekly_demand_867
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.week_end_date >= DATEADD(WEEK, -51, m.max_week_end_date)
    GROUP BY d.week_end_date
),
weekly_demand_867_pap_cte AS (
    SELECT
        p.week_end_date,
        SUM(p.qty_sold) AS weekly_demand_867_pap
    FROM data_867_pap p
    CROSS JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
    WHERE p.valid_order = 1
      AND p.week_end_date >= DATEADD(WEEK, -51, m.max_week_end_date)
    GROUP BY p.week_end_date
),
weekly_combined_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(a.week_end_date, b.week_end_date) AS week_end_date,
        COALESCE(a.weekly_demand_867, 0) + COALESCE(b.weekly_demand_867_pap, 0) AS weekly_demand_vials_r52w
    FROM weekly_demand_867_cte a
    FULL OUTER JOIN weekly_demand_867_pap_cte b
        ON a.week_end_date = b.week_end_date
),
weekly_business_days_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d.week_end_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_business_day = 1 THEN d.transaction_date END) AS business_days_count
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
    WHERE d.week_end_date >= DATEADD(WEEK, -51, m.max_week_end_date)
    GROUP BY d.week_end_date
),
weekly_final_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, c.week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
        c.week_end_date,
        b.business_days_count,
        ROUND(c.weekly_demand_vials_r52w, 0) AS weekly_demand_vials_r52w,
        ROUND(c.weekly_demand_vials_r52w / NULLIF(b.business_days_count, 0), 1) AS daily_average_demand_vials_r52w
    FROM weekly_combined_demand_cte c
    LEFT JOIN weekly_business_days_cte b
        ON c.week_end_date = b.week_end_date
)
SELECT
    week_start_date,
    week_end_date,
    business_days_count,
    weekly_demand_vials_r52w,
    daily_average_demand_vials_r52w
FROM weekly_final_cte
ORDER BY week_end_date ASC;

Include absolute demand volumes for both comparison periods, business day counts for both periods, period boundaries, daily average demand for both periods, and growth metrics. WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867
        UNION ALL
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867_pap
    ) w
),
r8w_period_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -55, max_week_end_date) AS r8w_start_date,
        max_week_end_date AS r8w_end_date
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte
),
p8w_period_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -56, r.r8w_start_date) AS p8w_start_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -1, r.r8w_start_date) AS p8w_end_date
    FROM r8w_period_cte r
),
r8w_demand_data_867_cte AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(d.qty_sold), 0), 0) AS demand_vials_r8w_data_867
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN r8w_period_cte r
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.week_end_date BETWEEN r.r8w_start_date AND r.r8w_end_date
),
r8w_demand_data_867_pap_cte AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(p.qty_sold), 0), 0) AS demand_vials_r8w_data_867_pap
    FROM data_867_pap p
    CROSS JOIN r8w_period_cte r
    WHERE p.valid_order = 1
      AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND p.week_end_date BETWEEN r.r8w_start_date AND r.r8w_end_date
),
p8w_demand_data_867_cte AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(d.qty_sold), 0), 0) AS demand_vials_p8w_data_867
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN p8w_period_cte p8
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.week_end_date BETWEEN p8.p8w_start_date AND p8.p8w_end_date
),
p8w_demand_data_867_pap_cte AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(p.qty_sold), 0), 0) AS demand_vials_p8w_data_867_pap
    FROM data_867_pap p
    CROSS JOIN p8w_period_cte p8
    WHERE p.valid_order = 1
      AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
      AND p.week_end_date BETWEEN p8.p8w_start_date AND p8.p8w_end_date
),
national_business_days_r8w_cte AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_business_day = 1 THEN d.transaction_date END) AS business_days_r8w
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN r8w_period_cte r
    WHERE d.transaction_date BETWEEN r.r8w_start_date AND r.r8w_end_date
),
national_business_days_p8w_cte AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_business_day = 1 THEN d.transaction_date END) AS business_days_p8w
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN p8w_period_cte p8
    WHERE d.transaction_date BETWEEN p8.p8w_start_date AND p8.p8w_end_date
),
final_metrics_cte AS (
    SELECT
        r.r8w_start_date,
        r.r8w_end_date,
        p8.p8w_start_date,
        p8.p8w_end_date,
        br.business_days_r8w,
        bp.business_days_p8w,
        (r867.demand_vials_r8w_data_867 + rpap.demand_vials_r8w_data_867_pap) AS demand_vials_r8w,
        (p867.demand_vials_p8w_data_867 + ppap.demand_vials_p8w_data_867_pap) AS demand_vials_p8w,
        ROUND((r867.demand_vials_r8w_data_867 + rpap.demand_vials_r8w_data_867_pap) / NULLIF(br.business_days_r8w, 0), 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_r8w,
        ROUND((p867.demand_vials_p8w_data_867 + ppap.demand_vials_p8w_data_867_pap) / NULLIF(bp.business_days_p8w, 0), 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_p8w
    FROM r8w_period_cte r
    CROSS JOIN p8w_period_cte p8
    CROSS JOIN r8w_demand_data_867_cte r867
    CROSS JOIN r8w_demand_data_867_pap_cte rpap
    CROSS JOIN p8w_demand_data_867_cte p867
    CROSS JOIN p8w_demand_data_867_pap_cte ppap
    CROSS JOIN national_business_days_r8w_cte br
    CROSS JOIN national_business_days_p8w_cte bp
)
SELECT
    f.r8w_start_date,
    f.r8w_end_date,
    f.p8w_start_date,
    f.p8w_end_date,
    f.business_days_r8w,
    f.business_days_p8w,
    f.demand_vials_r8w,
    f.demand_vials_p8w,
    f.daily_avg_demand_vials_r8w,
    f.daily_avg_demand_vials_p8w,
    CONCAT(
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN f.demand_vials_p8w = 0 AND f.demand_vials_r8w > 0 THEN 100
                ELSE ((f.demand_vials_r8w - f.demand_vials_p8w) / NULLIF(f.demand_vials_p8w, 0)) * 100
            END,
            1
        ),
        '%'
    ) AS growth_total_r8w_vs_p8w,
    CONCAT(
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN f.daily_avg_demand_vials_p8w = 0 AND f.daily_avg_demand_vials_r8w > 0 THEN 100
                ELSE ((f.daily_avg_demand_vials_r8w - f.daily_avg_demand_vials_p8w) / NULLIF(f.daily_avg_demand_vials_p8w, 0)) * 100
            END,
            1
        ),
        '%'
    ) AS growth_daily_avg_r8w_vs_p8w
FROM final_metrics_cte f
LIMIT 1;

query_decomposition.intent_summary: Calculate current quarter commercial demand growth versus the previous quarter at the national level, using total demand only if both quarters are complete and otherwise using daily average growth only, while always including the corresponding absolute volume demand values and business day counts.

subqueries.name: max_week_end_date_cte
subqueries.purpose: Identify the most recent available week_end_date across commercial demand sources to determine the current quarter.
subqueries.logic: Compute the maximum week_end_date across data_867 and data_867_pap filtered to commercial demand scope, where data_867 contributes all rows and data_867_pap contributes rows with transaction_type = 'COM'.

subqueries.name: current_quarter_cte
subqueries.purpose: Determine the current quarter_year and its calendar start and end dates based on the quarter containing the max_week_end_date.
subqueries.logic: Using max_week_end_date, derive the calendar quarter containing that date, assign its quarter_year label, quarter_start_date as the first day of that quarter, and quarter_end_date as the last day of that quarter.

subqueries.name: previous_quarter_cte
subqueries.purpose: Determine the previous quarter_year and its calendar start and end dates.
subqueries.logic: From current_quarter_cte, derive the immediately preceding calendar quarter, assign its quarter_year label, previous_quarter_start_date as the first day of that quarter, and previous_quarter_end_date as the last day of that quarter.

subqueries.name: period_completeness_cte
subqueries.purpose: Check whether the current quarter and previous quarter are complete according to calendar quarter ends.
subqueries.logic: Set is_current_quarter_complete to 1 when max_week_end_date >= current quarter_end_date else 0. Set is_previous_quarter_complete to 1 when max_week_end_date >= previous quarter_end_date else 0.

subqueries.name: current_quarter_demand_cte
subqueries.purpose: Calculate current quarter commercial demand across both demand tables.
subqueries.logic: Sum qty_sold from data_867 where valid_order = 1 and quarter_year equals current quarter_year, plus sum qty_sold from data_867_pap where valid_order = 1 and transaction_type = 'COM' and quarter_year equals current quarter_year.

subqueries.name: previous_quarter_demand_cte
subqueries.purpose: Calculate previous quarter commercial demand across both demand tables.
subqueries.logic: Sum qty_sold from data_867 where valid_order = 1 and quarter_year equals previous quarter_year, plus sum qty_sold from data_867_pap where valid_order = 1 and transaction_type = 'COM' and quarter_year equals previous quarter_year.

subqueries.name: current_quarter_business_days_cte
subqueries.purpose: Calculate the national business day denominator for the current quarter using distinct business dates only.
subqueries.logic: Count distinct transaction_date where is_business_day = 1 across the national-level commercial demand data for the current quarter. Use quarter_year equal to current quarter_year and deduplicate dates across data_867 and data_867_pap commercial rows so business days are counted once nationally.

subqueries.name: previous_quarter_business_days_cte
subqueries.purpose: Calculate the national business day denominator for the previous quarter using distinct business dates only.
subqueries.logic: Count distinct transaction_date where is_business_day = 1 across the national-level commercial demand data for the previous quarter. Use quarter_year equal to previous quarter_year and deduplicate dates across data_867 and data_867_pap commercial rows so business days are counted once nationally.

subqueries.name: growth_calculation_cte
subqueries.purpose: Compute daily average demand for both quarters and calculate growth metrics following completeness rules.
subqueries.logic: Compute current quarter daily average as current quarter demand divided by current quarter distinct national business days. Compute previous quarter daily average as previous quarter demand divided by previous quarter distinct national business days. If previous quarter daily average = 0 and current quarter daily average > 0, set daily average growth to 100. If both quarters are complete, also compute total growth as ((current quarter demand - previous quarter demand) / previous quarter demand) * 100, with the rule that if previous quarter demand = 0 and current quarter demand > 0 then total growth = 100. If any quarter is incomplete, omit total growth entirely from final output.

validation_rules: Use only data_867 and data_867_pap for actual demand.
For demand, always anchor to qty_sold and filter valid_order = 1 in both tables.
Because the query does not explicitly request Commercial + PAP, default to Commercial demand only; therefore include all rows from data_867 and only transaction_type = 'COM' rows from data_867_pap.
Determine the current quarter using the quarter containing MAX(week_end_date), not system date.
Quarter boundaries must be calendar quarter boundaries, not dataset min/max dates.

Previous quarter completeness must also be evaluated against its calendar quarter end date.
Daily average must equal total demand divided by COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_date where is_business_day = 1) at the national level only.
Business day counts must be deduplicated by date and must never be derived from regional, parent, child, or segmented subsets.
Always include corresponding absolute volume demand values with growth metrics.
If both quarters are complete, include both total growth and daily average growth.
If either quarter is incomplete, do not generate or include growth_total_cq_vs_pq_pct in the output schema.
If either quarter is incomplete, include only daily average growth along with demand_vials_cq and demand_vials_pq.
If previous quarter demand is 0 and current quarter demand is greater than 0, total growth must be 100% when total growth is eligible to be shown.
If previous quarter daily average is 0 and current quarter daily average is greater than 0, daily average growth must be 100%.
Round demand outputs to the nearest integer.
Round daily average outputs to exactly 1 decimal place.
Include explicit start and end dates for both current and previous quarters in the output.
Do not group by parent_id or parent_name because the query asks for default national demand.

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT week_end_date
        FROM data_867
        WHERE valid_order = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT week_end_date
        FROM data_867_pap
        WHERE valid_order = 1
          AND transaction_type = 'COM'
    ) t
),
current_quarter_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', max_week_end_date) AS current_quarter_start_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(QUARTER, 1, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', max_week_end_date))) AS current_quarter_end_date,
        TO_VARCHAR(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', max_week_end_date), 'YYYY') || '-Q' || TO_VARCHAR(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM max_week_end_date)) AS current_quarter_year
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte
),
previous_quarter_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(QUARTER, -1, current_quarter_start_date) AS previous_quarter_start_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -1, current_quarter_start_date) AS previous_quarter_end_date,
        TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD(QUARTER, -1, current_quarter_start_date), 'YYYY') || '-Q' || TO_VARCHAR(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM DATEADD(QUARTER, -1, current_quarter_start_date))) AS previous_quarter_year
    FROM current_quarter_cte
),
period_completeness_cte AS (
    SELECT
        m.max_week_end_date,
        c.current_quarter_start_date,
        c.current_quarter_end_date,
        c.current_quarter_year,
        p.previous_quarter_start_date,
        p.previous_quarter_end_date,
        p.previous_quarter_year,
        CASE WHEN m.max_week_end_date >= c.current_quarter_end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_current_quarter_complete,
        CASE WHEN m.max_week_end_date >= p.previous_quarter_end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_previous_quarter_complete
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte m
    CROSS JOIN current_quarter_cte c
    CROSS JOIN previous_quarter_cte p
),
current_quarter_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(d.qty_sold)
                FROM data_867 d
                CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
                WHERE d.valid_order = 1
                  AND d.quarter_year = pc.current_quarter_year
            ), 0)
            +
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(p.qty_sold)
                FROM data_867_pap p
                CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
                WHERE p.valid_order = 1
                  AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
                  AND p.quarter_year = pc.current_quarter_year
            ), 0)
        , 0) AS demand_vials_cq
),
previous_quarter_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(d.qty_sold)
                FROM data_867 d
                CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
                WHERE d.valid_order = 1
                  AND d.quarter_year = pc.previous_quarter_year
            ), 0)
            +
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(p.qty_sold)
                FROM data_867_pap p
                CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
                WHERE p.valid_order = 1
                  AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
                  AND p.quarter_year = pc.previous_quarter_year
            ), 0)
        , 0) AS demand_vials_pq
),
current_quarter_business_days_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_date) AS business_days_cq
    FROM (
        SELECT d.transaction_date
        FROM data_867 d
        CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
        WHERE d.valid_order = 1
          AND d.is_business_day = 1
          AND d.quarter_year = pc.current_quarter_year
        UNION
        SELECT p.transaction_date
        FROM data_867_pap p
        CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
        WHERE p.valid_order = 1
          AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
          AND p.is_business_day = 1
          AND p.quarter_year = pc.current_quarter_year
    ) b
),
previous_quarter_business_days_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_date) AS business_days_pq
    FROM (
        SELECT d.transaction_date
        FROM data_867 d
        CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
        WHERE d.valid_order = 1
          AND d.is_business_day = 1
          AND d.quarter_year = pc.previous_quarter_year
        UNION
        SELECT p.transaction_date
        FROM data_867_pap p
        CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
        WHERE p.valid_order = 1
          AND p.transaction_type = 'COM'
          AND p.is_business_day = 1
          AND p.quarter_year = pc.previous_quarter_year
    ) b
),
growth_calculation_cte AS (
    SELECT
        pc.current_quarter_start_date,
        pc.current_quarter_end_date,
        pc.previous_quarter_start_date,
        pc.previous_quarter_end_date,
        cbd.business_days_cq,
        pbd.business_days_pq,
        cqd.demand_vials_cq,
        pqd.demand_vials_pq,
        ROUND(cqd.demand_vials_cq / NULLIF(cbd.business_days_cq, 0), 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_cq,
        ROUND(pqd.demand_vials_pq / NULLIF(pbd.business_days_pq, 0), 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_pq,
        CASE
            WHEN ROUND(pqd.demand_vials_pq / NULLIF(pbd.business_days_pq, 0), 1) = 0
                 AND ROUND(cqd.demand_vials_cq / NULLIF(cbd.business_days_cq, 0), 1) > 0 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(100, 1), '%')
            ELSE CONCAT(
                ROUND(
                    (
                        (cqd.demand_vials_cq / NULLIF(cbd.business_days_cq, 0))
                        - (pqd.demand_vials_pq / NULLIF(pbd.business_days_pq, 0))
                    ) / NULLIF((pqd.demand_vials_pq / NULLIF(pbd.business_days_pq, 0)), 0) * 100
                , 1)
            , '%')
        END AS growth_daily_avg_cq_vs_pq_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN pc.is_current_quarter_complete = 1
             AND pc.is_previous_quarter_complete = 1 THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN pqd.demand_vials_pq = 0 AND cqd.demand_vials_cq > 0 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(100, 1), '%')
                    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(((cqd.demand_vials_cq - pqd.demand_vials_pq) / NULLIF(pqd.demand_vials_pq, 0)) * 100, 1), '%')
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS growth_total_cq_vs_pq_pct,
        pc.is_current_quarter_complete,
        pc.is_previous_quarter_complete
    FROM period_completeness_cte pc
    CROSS JOIN current_quarter_demand_cte cqd
    CROSS JOIN previous_quarter_demand_cte pqd
    CROSS JOIN current_quarter_business_days_cte cbd
    CROSS JOIN previous_quarter_business_days_cte pbd
)
SELECT
    current_quarter_start_date,
    current_quarter_end_date,
    previous_quarter_start_date,
    previous_quarter_end_date,
    business_days_cq,
    business_days_pq,
    demand_vials_cq,
    demand_vials_pq,
    daily_avg_demand_vials_cq,
    daily_avg_demand_vials_pq,
    growth_daily_avg_cq_vs_pq_pct,
    growth_total_cq_vs_pq_pct
FROM growth_calculation_cte
WHERE is_current_quarter_complete = 1
  AND is_previous_quarter_complete = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
    current_quarter_start_date,
    current_quarter_end_date,
    previous_quarter_start_date,
    previous_quarter_end_date,
    business_days_cq,
    business_days_pq,
    demand_vials_cq,
    demand_vials_pq,
    daily_avg_demand_vials_cq,
    daily_avg_demand_vials_pq,
    growth_daily_avg_cq_vs_pq_pct,
    NULL AS growth_total_cq_vs_pq_pct
FROM growth_calculation_cte

WITH unified_demand AS (
    SELECT
        parent_id,
        parent_name,
        child_id,
        child_name,
        transaction_date,
        week_end_date,
        is_business_day,
        qty_sold
    FROM data_867
    WHERE valid_order = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        parent_id,
        parent_name,
        child_id,
        child_name,
        transaction_date,
        week_end_date,
        is_business_day,
        qty_sold
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND transaction_type IN ('COM', 'PAP')
),
max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM unified_demand
),
week_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        wd.week_end_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wd.week_end_date DESC) AS week_rank_desc
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT week_end_date
        FROM unified_demand
    ) wd
    JOIN max_week_end_date_cte m
      ON wd.week_end_date <= m.max_week_end_date
),
period_weeks AS (
    SELECT
        week_end_date,
        CASE
            WHEN week_rank_desc BETWEEN 1 AND 8 THEN 'R8W'
            WHEN week_rank_desc BETWEEN 9 AND 16 THEN 'P8W'
        END AS period_label
    FROM week_ranked
    WHERE week_rank_desc BETWEEN 1 AND 16
),
period_boundaries_cte AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(CASE WHEN period_label = 'R8W' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, week_end_date) END) AS recent_period_start_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period_label = 'R8W' THEN week_end_date END) AS recent_period_end_date,
        MIN(CASE WHEN period_label = 'P8W' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, week_end_date) END) AS prior_period_start_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period_label = 'P8W' THEN week_end_date END) AS prior_period_end_date
    FROM period_weeks
),
business_days_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pw.period_label = 'R8W' AND u.is_business_day = 1 THEN u.transaction_date END) AS recent_period_business_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pw.period_label = 'P8W' AND u.is_business_day = 1 THEN u.transaction_date END) AS prior_period_business_days
    FROM unified_demand u
    JOIN period_weeks pw
      ON u.week_end_date = pw.week_end_date
),
account_period_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        u.parent_id,
        u.parent_name,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pw.period_label = 'R8W' THEN u.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS demand_vials_r8w,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pw.period_label = 'P8W' THEN u.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS demand_vials_p8w
    FROM unified_demand u
    JOIN period_weeks pw
      ON u.week_end_date = pw.week_end_date
    GROUP BY
        u.parent_id,
        u.parent_name
),
national_growth_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pw.period_label = 'R8W' THEN u.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS national_demand_vials_r8w,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pw.period_label = 'P8W' THEN u.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS national_demand_vials_p8w
    FROM unified_demand u
    JOIN period_weeks pw
      ON u.week_end_date = pw.week_end_date
),
account_growth_cte AS (
    SELECT
        a.parent_id,
        a.parent_name,
        a.demand_vials_r8w,
        a.demand_vials_p8w,
        ROUND(a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) AS daily_average_demand_vials_r8w,
        ROUND(a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1) AS daily_average_demand_vials_p8w,
        CONCAT(
            ROUND(
                CASE
                    WHEN ROUND(a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1) = 0
                         AND ROUND(a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) > 0
                    THEN 100
                    ELSE (
                        (ROUND(a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) - ROUND(a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1))
                        / NULLIF(ROUND(a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1), 0)
                    ) * 100
                END
            , 1),
            '%'
        ) AS daily_average_growth_pct_r8w_vs_p8w
    FROM account_period_demand_cte a
    CROSS JOIN business_days_cte b
),
national_daily_growth_cte AS (
    SELECT
        n.national_demand_vials_r8w,
        n.national_demand_vials_p8w,
        ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) AS national_daily_average_demand_vials_r8w,
        ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1) AS national_daily_average_demand_vials_p8w,
        CONCAT(
            ROUND(
                CASE
                    WHEN ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1) = 0
                         AND ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) > 0
                    THEN 100
                    ELSE (
                        (ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) - ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1))
                        / NULLIF(ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1), 0)
                    ) * 100
                END
            , 1),
            '%'
        ) AS national_daily_average_growth_pct_r8w_vs_p8w,
        CASE
            WHEN ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) > ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1)
                 AND ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1) = 0
            THEN 100
            ELSE ROUND(
                (
                    (ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.recent_period_business_days, 0), 1) - ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1))
                    / NULLIF(ROUND(n.national_demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.prior_period_business_days, 0), 1), 0)
                ) * 100
            , 1)
        END AS national_daily_growth_numeric
    FROM national_growth_cte n
    CROSS JOIN business_days_cte b
),
top_25_accounts_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ag.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ag.demand_vials_r8w DESC) AS rn
    FROM account_growth_cte ag

WITH demand_union_cte AS (
    SELECT
        parent_id,
        parent_name,
        qty_sold,
        transaction_date,
        week_end_date,
        year,
        is_business_day
    FROM data_867
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND year >= 2025
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        parent_id,
        parent_name,
        qty_sold,
        transaction_date,
        week_end_date,
        year,
        is_business_day
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND year >= 2025
      AND transaction_type IN ('COM', 'PAP')
),
max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM demand_union_cte
),
period_boundaries_cte AS (
    SELECT
        max_week_end_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -7, max_week_end_date) AS recent_period_start_date,
        max_week_end_date AS recent_period_end_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -15, max_week_end_date) AS prior_period_start_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -8, max_week_end_date) AS prior_period_end_date
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte
),
period_completeness_cte AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.recent_period_start_date AND p.recent_period_end_date THEN d.week_end_date END) = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_recent_period_complete,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.prior_period_start_date AND p.prior_period_end_date THEN d.week_end_date END) = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_previous_period_complete
    FROM demand_union_cte d
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte p
),
top25_parent_accounts_cte AS (
    SELECT
        parent_id,
        parent_name,
        ROUND(SUM(qty_sold), 0) AS demand_vials_since2025
    FROM demand_union_cte
    GROUP BY parent_id, parent_name
    ORDER BY demand_vials_since2025 DESC
    LIMIT 25
),
account_period_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        t.parent_id,
        t.parent_name,
        t.demand_vials_since2025,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.recent_period_start_date AND p.recent_period_end_date THEN d.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS demand_vials_r8w,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.prior_period_start_date AND p.prior_period_end_date THEN d.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS demand_vials_p8w
    FROM top25_parent_accounts_cte t
    LEFT JOIN demand_union_cte d
        ON t.parent_id = d.parent_id
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte p
    GROUP BY t.parent_id, t.parent_name, t.demand_vials_since2025
),
national_period_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.recent_period_start_date AND p.recent_period_end_date THEN d.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS demand_vials_r8w_national,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.prior_period_start_date AND p.prior_period_end_date THEN d.qty_sold ELSE 0 END), 0) AS demand_vials_p8w_national
    FROM demand_union_cte d
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte p
),
business_days_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.recent_period_start_date AND p.recent_period_end_date AND d.is_business_day = 1 THEN d.transaction_date END) AS business_days_r8w,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.prior_period_start_date AND p.prior_period_end_date AND d.is_business_day = 1 THEN d.transaction_date END) AS business_days_p8w
    FROM demand_union_cte d
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte p
)
SELECT
    a.parent_id,
    a.parent_name,
    a.demand_vials_since2025,
    a.demand_vials_r8w,
    a.demand_vials_p8w,
    b.business_days_r8w,
    b.business_days_p8w,
    TO_DECIMAL(ROUND(a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0), 1), 10, 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_r8w,
    TO_DECIMAL(ROUND(a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0), 1), 10, 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_p8w,
    CONCAT(
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN (a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)) = 0 AND (a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) > 0 THEN 100
                ELSE (((a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) - (a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0))) / NULLIF((a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)), 0)) * 100
            END
        , 1),
        '%'
    ) AS daily_avg_growth_r8w_vs_p8w_pct,
    n.demand_vials_r8w_national,
    n.demand_vials_p8w_national,
    TO_DECIMAL(ROUND(n.demand_vials_r8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0), 1), 10, 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_r8w_national,
    TO_DECIMAL(ROUND(n.demand_vials_p8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0), 1), 10, 1) AS daily_avg_demand_vials_p8w_national,
    CONCAT(
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN (n.demand_vials_p8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)) = 0 AND (n.demand_vials_r8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) > 0 THEN 100
                ELSE (((n.demand_vials_r8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) - (n.demand_vials_p8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0))) / NULLIF((n.demand_vials_p8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)), 0)) * 100
            END
        , 1),
        '%'
    ) AS daily_avg_growth_r8w_vs_p8w_pct_national,
    CASE
        WHEN
            CASE
                WHEN (a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)) = 0 AND (a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) > 0 THEN 100
                ELSE (((a.demand_vials_r8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) - (a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0))) / NULLIF((a.demand_vials_p8w / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)), 0)) * 100
            END
            >=
            CASE
                WHEN (n.demand_vials_p8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)) = 0 AND (n.demand_vials_r8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) > 0 THEN 100
                ELSE (((n.demand_vials_r8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_r8w, 0)) - (n.demand_vials_p8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0))) / NULLIF((n.demand_vials_p8w_national / NULLIF(b.business_days_p8w, 0)), 0)) * 100
            END
        THEN 'Higher'
        ELSE 'Lower'
    END AS vs_national_daily_avg_growth_flag,
    p.recent_period_start_date,
    p.recent_period_end_date,
    p.prior_period_start_date,
    p.prior_period_end_date
FROM account_period_demand_cte a
CROSS JOIN national_period_demand_cte n
CROSS JOIN business_days_cte b
CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte p
CROSS JOIN period_completeness_cte pc
ORDER BY a.demand_vials_since2025 DESC
LIMIT 25;

),
east_weekly_commercial_demand_cte AS (

),

    SELECT n.week_end_date,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN n.is_business_day = 1 THEN n.transaction_date END) AS weekly_business_days_national
    FROM (

    ) d

      AND week_end_date <= (SELECT window_end_week_end_date FROM rolling_window_cte)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        region,
        child_id,
        qty_sold,
        week_end_date
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1

        child_id,
        week_end_date

        child_id,

    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0

max_activity_week AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM activity_union
),
analysis_weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        au.week_end_date
    FROM activity_union au
    CROSS JOIN max_activity_week maw
    WHERE au.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -7, maw.max_week_end_date) AND maw.max_week_end_date
),
universe_by_week AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        aw.week_end_date AS analysis_week_end_date,
        au.child_id
    FROM analysis_weeks aw
    JOIN activity_union au
      ON au.week_end_date <= aw.week_end_date
),
dormant_accounts_by_week AS (
    SELECT
        ubw.analysis_week_end_date AS week_end_date,
        ubw.child_id
    FROM universe_by_week ubw
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM activity_union a2
        WHERE a2.child_id = ubw.child_id
          AND a2.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -7, ubw.analysis_week_end_date) AND ubw.analysis_week_end_date
    )
),
weekly_dormant_counts AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, aw.week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
        aw.week_end_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT daw.child_id) AS weekly_dormant_accounts
    FROM analysis_weeks aw
    LEFT JOIN dormant_accounts_by_week daw

        week_start_date,
        aw.week_end_date
),
dormant_addition_trend AS (
    SELECT
        week_start_date,
        week_end_date,
        weekly_dormant_accounts,
        weekly_dormant_accounts - LAG(weekly_dormant_accounts) OVER (ORDER BY week_end_date) AS dormant_additions
    FROM weekly_dormant_counts
)
SELECT
    week_start_date,
    week_end_date,
    weekly_dormant_accounts,
    dormant_additions
FROM dormant_addition_trend
ORDER BY week_end_date ASC;

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867 WHERE valid_order = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT week_end_date FROM data_867_pap WHERE valid_order = 1
    ) x
),
period_boundaries_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(WEEK, -7, max_week_end_date) AS recent_period_start_date,
        max_week_end_date AS recent_period_end_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -15, max_week_end_date) AS prior_period_start_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -8, max_week_end_date) AS prior_period_end_date
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte
),
top_75_parent_accounts_cte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pmt.parent_id,
        pmt.parent_name
    FROM parent_marketing_target pmt
    WHERE pmt.parent_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY pmt.parent_name
    LIMIT 75
),
r8w_867 AS (
    SELECT
        d.parent_id,
        SUM(d.qty_sold) AS demand_vials_r8w_data_867
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte pb
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.week_end_date BETWEEN pb.recent_period_start_date AND pb.recent_period_end_date
    GROUP BY d.parent_id
),
r8w_867_pap AS (
    SELECT
        p.parent_id,
        SUM(p.qty_sold) AS demand_vials_r8w_data_867_pap
    FROM data_867_pap p
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte pb
    WHERE p.valid_order = 1
      AND p.week_end_date BETWEEN pb.recent_period_start_date AND pb.recent_period_end_date
    GROUP BY p.parent_id
),
r8w_demand_by_parent_cte AS (
    SELECT
        t.parent_id,
        COALESCE(r8.demand_vials_r8w_data_867, 0) + COALESCE(r8p.demand_vials_r8w_data_867_pap, 0) AS demand_vials_r8w
    FROM top_75_parent_accounts_cte t
    LEFT JOIN r8w_867 r8
        ON t.parent_id = r8.parent_id
    LEFT JOIN r8w_867_pap r8p
        ON t.parent_id = r8p.parent_id
),
p8w_867 AS (
    SELECT
        d.parent_id,
        SUM(d.qty_sold) AS demand_vials_p8w_data_867
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte pb
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.week_end_date BETWEEN pb.prior_period_start_date AND pb.prior_period_end_date
    GROUP BY d.parent_id
),
p8w_867_pap AS (
    SELECT
        p.parent_id,
        SUM(p.qty_sold) AS demand_vials_p8w_data_867_pap
    FROM data_867_pap p
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte pb
    WHERE p.valid_order = 1
      AND p.week_end_date BETWEEN pb.prior_period_start_date AND pb.prior_period_end_date
    GROUP BY p.parent_id
),
p8w_demand_by_parent_cte AS (
    SELECT
        t.parent_id,
        COALESCE(p8.demand_vials_p8w_data_867, 0) + COALESCE(p8p.demand_vials_p8w_data_867_pap, 0) AS demand_vials_p8w
    FROM top_75_parent_accounts_cte t
    LEFT JOIN p8w_867 p8
        ON t.parent_id = p8.parent_id
    LEFT JOIN p8w_867_pap p8p
        ON t.parent_id = p8p.parent_id
),
growth_calc_cte AS (
    SELECT
        t.parent_id,
        t.parent_name,
        pb.recent_period_start_date,
        pb.recent_period_end_date,
        pb.prior_period_start_date,
        pb.prior_period_end_date,
        COALESCE(r.demand_vials_r8w, 0) AS demand_vials_r8w,
        COALESCE(p.demand_vials_p8w, 0) AS demand_vials_p8w,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(p.demand_vials_p8w, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(r.demand_vials_r8w, 0) > 0 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(100.0, 1), '%')
            WHEN COALESCE(p.demand_vials_p8w, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(r.demand_vials_r8w, 0) = 0 THEN CONCAT(ROUND(0.0, 1), '%')
            ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(((COALESCE(r.demand_vials_r8w, 0) - COALESCE(p.demand_vials_p8w, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(p.demand_vials_p8w, 0), 0)) * 100, 1), '%')
        END AS growth_r8w_pct
    FROM top_75_parent_accounts_cte t
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte pb
    LEFT JOIN r8w_demand_by_parent_cte r
        ON t.parent_id = r.parent_id
    LEFT JOIN p8w_demand_by_parent_cte p
        ON t.parent_id = p.parent_id
)
SELECT
    parent_id,
    parent_name,
    recent_period_start_date,
    recent_period_end_date,
    prior_period_start_date,
    prior_period_end_date,
    demand_vials_r8w,
    demand_vials_p8w,
    growth_r8w_pct
FROM growth_calc_cte
ORDER BY
    TO_DECIMAL(REPLACE(growth_r8w_pct, '%', '')) DESC,
    demand_vials_r8w DESC,
    parent_name ASC
LIMIT 75;

WITH max_week_end_date_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT week_end_date
        FROM data_867
        WHERE valid_order = 1
        UNION ALL
        SELECT week_end_date
        FROM data_867_pap
        WHERE valid_order = 1
    ) w
),
period_boundaries_cte AS (
    SELECT
        max_week_end_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -7, max_week_end_date) AS r8w_start_week_end_date,
        max_week_end_date AS r8w_end_week_end_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -15, max_week_end_date) AS p8w_start_week_end_date,
        DATEADD(WEEK, -8, max_week_end_date) AS p8w_end_week_end_date
    FROM max_week_end_date_cte
),
commercial_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d.parent_id,
        d.parent_name,
        CASE
            WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.r8w_start_week_end_date AND p.r8w_end_week_end_date THEN 'R8W'
            WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.p8w_start_week_end_date AND p.p8w_end_week_end_date THEN 'P8W'
        END AS period_bucket,
        SUM(d.qty_sold) AS demand_vials
    FROM data_867 d
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte p
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.p8w_start_week_end_date AND p.r8w_end_week_end_date
    GROUP BY d.parent_id, d.parent_name, period_bucket
),
pap_com_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d.parent_id,
        d.parent_name,
        CASE
            WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.r8w_start_week_end_date AND p.r8w_end_week_end_date THEN 'R8W'
            WHEN d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.p8w_start_week_end_date AND p.p8w_end_week_end_date THEN 'P8W'
        END AS period_bucket,
        SUM(d.qty_sold) AS demand_vials
    FROM data_867_pap d
    CROSS JOIN period_boundaries_cte p
    WHERE d.valid_order = 1
      AND d.week_end_date BETWEEN p.p8w_start_week_end_date AND p.r8w_end_week_end_date
    GROUP BY d.parent_id, d.parent_name, period_bucket
),
combined_parent_period_demand_cte AS (
    SELECT
        x.parent_id,
        x.parent_name,
        x.period_bucket,
        SUM(x.demand_vials) AS demand_vials
    FROM (
        SELECT parent_id, parent_name, period_bucket, demand_vials FROM commercial_demand_cte
        UNION ALL
        SELECT parent_id, parent_name, period_bucket, demand_vials FROM pap_com_demand_cte
    ) x
    GROUP BY x.parent_id, x.parent_name, x.period_bucket
),
target_parent_anchor_cte AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        parent_id,
        parent_name
    FROM parent_marketing_target
),
ranked_top75_parents_cte AS (
    SELECT
        t.parent_id,
        t.parent_name,
        COALESCE(r.demand_vials, 0) AS demand_vials_r8w_parent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(r.demand_vials, 0) DESC, t.parent_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM target_parent_anchor_cte t
    LEFT JOIN combined_parent_period_demand_cte r
        ON t.parent_id = r.parent_id
       AND r.period_bucket = 'R8W'
),
top75_combined_totals_cte AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT rt.parent_id) AS top_75_account_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.period_bucket = 'R8W' THEN c.demand_vials ELSE 0 END) AS combined_demand_vials_r8w_top75,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.period_bucket = 'P8W' THEN c.demand_vials ELSE 0 END) AS combined_demand_vials_p8w_top75
    FROM ranked_top75_parents_cte rt
    LEFT JOIN combined_parent_period_demand_cte c
        ON rt.parent_id = c.parent_id
    WHERE rt.rn <= 75
),
period_dates_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, r8w_start_week_end_date) AS recent_period_start_date,
        r8w_end_week_end_date AS recent_period_end_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, p8w_start_week_end_date) AS prior_period_start_date,
        p8w_end_week_end_date AS prior_period_end_date
    FROM period_boundaries_cte
)
SELECT
    pd.recent_period_start_date,
    pd.recent_period_end_date,
    pd.prior_period_start_date,
    pd.prior_period_end_date,
    t.top_75_account_count,
    t.combined_demand_vials_r8w_top75,
    t.combined_demand_vials_p8w_top75,
    CONCAT(
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN t.combined_demand_vials_p8w_top75 = 0 AND t.combined_demand_vials_r8w_top75 > 0 THEN 100.0
                ELSE ((t.combined_demand_vials_r8w_top75 - t.combined_demand_vials_p8w_top75) / NULLIF(t.combined_demand_vials_p8w_top75, 0)) * 100
            END
        , 1),
        '%'
    ) AS growth_r8w_vs_p8w_top75
FROM top75_combined_totals_cte t
CROSS JOIN period_dates_cte pd;

WITH activity_union AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        child_id,
        week_end_date
    FROM data_867
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        child_id,
        week_end_date
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
),
max_week_end_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM activity_union
),
analysis_weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.week_end_date
    FROM activity_union a
    CROSS JOIN max_week_end_date m
    WHERE a.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -51, m.max_week_end_date) AND m.max_week_end_date
),
first_qualifying_activity AS (
    SELECT
        child_id,
        MIN(week_end_date) AS first_week_end_date
    FROM activity_union
    GROUP BY child_id
),
reactivation_flag_by_week AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        aw.week_end_date,
        ow.child_id
    FROM analysis_weeks aw
    JOIN activity_union ow
      ON ow.week_end_date = aw.week_end_date
    JOIN first_qualifying_activity fqa
      ON fqa.child_id = ow.child_id
    WHERE fqa.first_week_end_date < DATEADD(WEEK, -8, aw.week_end_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM activity_union d
          WHERE d.child_id = ow.child_id
            AND d.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -8, aw.week_end_date) AND DATEADD(WEEK, -1, aw.week_end_date)
      )
),
weekly_reactivated_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r.week_end_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, r.week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.child_id) AS reactivated_accounts
    FROM reactivation_flag_by_week r
    GROUP BY
        r.week_end_date,
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, r.week_end_date)
)
SELECT
    DATEADD(DAY, -6, aw.week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
    aw.week_end_date,
    COALESCE(wrc.reactivated_accounts, 0) AS reactivated_accounts
FROM analysis_weeks aw
LEFT JOIN weekly_reactivated_counts wrc
  ON aw.week_end_date = wrc.week_end_date
ORDER BY aw.week_end_date ASC;

WITH combined_activity AS (
    SELECT
        child_id,
        child_name,
        parent_id,
        parent_name,
        region,
        account_type,
        week_end_date,
        transaction_date,
        qty_sold
    FROM data_867
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        child_id,
        child_name,
        parent_id,
        parent_name,
        region,
        account_type,
        week_end_date,
        transaction_date,
        qty_sold
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
),
max_week_cte AS (
    SELECT MAX(week_end_date) AS max_week_end_date
    FROM combined_activity
),
recent_4_weeks AS (
    SELECT week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ca.week_end_date
        FROM combined_activity ca
        JOIN max_week_cte mw ON ca.week_end_date <= mw.max_week_end_date
        ORDER BY ca.week_end_date DESC
        LIMIT 4
    )
),
oldest_eval_week AS (
    SELECT MIN(week_end_date) AS oldest_week_end_date
    FROM recent_4_weeks
),
history_coverage_check AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN (
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.week_end_date)
                FROM combined_activity ca
                JOIN oldest_eval_week o
                  ON ca.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -8, o.oldest_week_end_date) AND o.oldest_week_end_date
            ) = 9 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS has_full_9_week_history
),
first_qualifying_order AS (
    SELECT
        child_id,
        MIN(week_end_date) AS first_qualifying_order_week_end_date
    FROM combined_activity
    GROUP BY child_id
),
weekly_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        child_id,
        child_name,
        week_end_date
    FROM combined_activity
),
reactivated_accounts_by_week AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, w.week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
        w.week_end_date,
        wo.child_id,
        wo.child_name
    FROM recent_4_weeks w
    JOIN weekly_orders wo
      ON wo.week_end_date = w.week_end_date
    JOIN first_qualifying_order fqo
      ON fqo.child_id = wo.child_id
    CROSS JOIN history_coverage_check hcc
    WHERE hcc.has_full_9_week_history = 1
      AND fqo.first_qualifying_order_week_end_date < DATEADD(WEEK, -8, w.week_end_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM weekly_orders wo_prior
          WHERE wo_prior.child_id = wo.child_id
            AND wo_prior.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -8, w.week_end_date) AND DATEADD(WEEK, -1, w.week_end_date)
      )
),
latest_order_date_by_child AS (
    SELECT
        child_id,
        MAX(transaction_date) AS latest_ordered_date
    FROM combined_activity
    GROUP BY child_id
),
latest_order_vials_by_child AS (
    SELECT
        ca.child_id,
        SUM(ca.qty_sold) AS latest_ordered_vials
    FROM combined_activity ca
    JOIN latest_order_date_by_child lod
      ON ca.child_id = lod.child_id
     AND ca.transaction_date = lod.latest_ordered_date
    GROUP BY ca.child_id
),
latest_date_distinct_attributes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ca.child_id,
        ca.parent_name,
        ca.region,
        ca.account_type
    FROM combined_activity ca
    JOIN latest_order_date_by_child lod
      ON ca.child_id = lod.child_id
     AND ca.transaction_date = lod.latest_ordered_date
),
latest_account_attributes_quality AS (
    SELECT
        child_id,
        COUNT(*) AS attribute_combo_count
    FROM latest_date_distinct_attributes
    GROUP BY child_id
),
latest_account_attributes_by_child AS (
    SELECT
        lda.child_id,
        lda.parent_name,
        lda.region,
        lda.account_type
    FROM latest_date_distinct_attributes lda
    JOIN latest_account_attributes_quality laq
      ON lda.child_id = laq.child_id
    WHERE laq.attribute_combo_count = 1
),
reactivated_accounts_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        raw.week_start_date,
        raw.week_end_date,
        raw.child_id,
        raw.child_name,
        lod.latest_ordered_date,
        lov.latest_ordered_vials,
        laa.parent_name,
        laa.region,
        laa.account_type
    FROM reactivated_accounts_by_week raw
    JOIN latest_order_date_by_child lod
      ON raw.child_id = lod.child_id
    JOIN latest_order_vials_by_child lov
      ON raw.child_id = lov.child_id
    JOIN latest_account_attributes_by_child laa
      ON raw.child_id = laa.child_id
)
SELECT
    week_start_date,
    week_end_date,
    child_id,
    child_name,
    latest_ordered_date,
    latest_ordered_vials,
    parent_name,
    region,
    account_type
FROM reactivated_accounts_enriched
GROUP BY
    week_start_date,
    week_end_date,
    child_id,
    child_name,
    latest_ordered_date,
    latest_ordered_vials,
    parent_name,
    region,
    account_type
ORDER BY
    week_end_date ASC,
    parent_name ASC,
    child_name ASC,
    child_id ASC;

week_start_date must equal week_end_date minus 6 days.

WITH activity_table AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        child_id,
        week_end_date
    FROM data_867
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        child_id,
        week_end_date
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
),
analysis_weeks AS (
    SELECT week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            week_end_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY week_end_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT week_end_date
            FROM activity_table
        ) w
    ) x
    WHERE rn <= 52
),
analysis_weeks_ordered AS (
    SELECT
        week_end_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY week_end_date ASC) AS week_seq
    FROM analysis_weeks
),
universe_by_week AS (
    SELECT
        aw.week_end_date,
        aw.week_seq,
        a.child_id
    FROM analysis_weeks_ordered aw
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            child_id,
            MIN(week_end_date) AS first_activity_week
        FROM activity_table
        GROUP BY child_id
    ) a
      ON a.first_activity_week <= aw.week_end_date
),
dormant_flag_by_week AS (
    SELECT
        u.week_end_date,
        u.week_seq,
        u.child_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(a.child_id) = 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_dormant
    FROM universe_by_week u
    LEFT JOIN activity_table a
      ON a.child_id = u.child_id
     AND a.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -7, u.week_end_date) AND u.week_end_date
    GROUP BY
        u.week_end_date,
        u.week_seq,
        u.child_id
),
weekly_dormant_counts AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
        week_end_date,
        week_seq,
        COUNT(DISTINCT child_id) AS weekly_dormant_accounts
    FROM dormant_flag_by_week
    WHERE is_dormant = 1
    GROUP BY
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, week_end_date),
        week_end_date,
        week_seq
),
dormant_additions_by_week AS (
    SELECT
        curr.week_end_date,
        curr.week_seq,
        CASE
            WHEN curr.week_seq = 1 THEN NULL
            ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT curr.child_id)
        END AS dormant_additions
    FROM dormant_flag_by_week curr
    LEFT JOIN dormant_flag_by_week prev
      ON prev.child_id = curr.child_id
     AND prev.week_seq = curr.week_seq - 1
    WHERE curr.is_dormant = 1
      AND (prev.child_id IS NULL OR prev.is_dormant = 0)
    GROUP BY
        curr.week_end_date,
        curr.week_seq
)
SELECT
    wdc.week_start_date,
    wdc.week_end_date,
    wdc.weekly_dormant_accounts,
    CASE
        WHEN wdc.week_seq = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE dabw.dormant_additions
    END AS dormant_additions
FROM weekly_dormant_counts wdc
LEFT JOIN dormant_additions_by_week dabw
  ON wdc.week_end_date = dabw.week_end_date
 AND wdc.week_seq = dabw.week_seq
ORDER BY wdc.week_end_date ASC;

subqueries.purpose: Aggregate dormant account counts by analysis week
subqueries.logic: For each analysis week W, compute week_start_date as W minus 6 days, retain week_end_date as W, and count distinct child_id values flagged as dormant.

validation_rules: Use only qualifying activity rows where valid_order = 1 and qty_sold > 0.
Activity source must be UNION DISTINCT of data_867 and data_867_pap at child_id and week_end_date grain.
For account-level logic, include both Commercial and PAP records from data_867_pap; do not restrict to transaction_type = 'COM'.
Analysis weeks must be the 8 most recent distinct week_end_date values found in the activity table.
Do not use system date or today's date to define the analysis window.
Universe for week W includes only child_id values with at least one activity row on or before W.
Dormant flag for week W requires zero activity rows in the inclusive window from W minus 7 weeks through W.
Count dormant accounts as COUNT of DISTINCT child_id per week_end_date.
Output must include week_start_date and week_end_date for every row.
Order final output by week_end_date ascending.
Because output is at weekly grain, suppress daily average and business day metrics.

WITH activity_table AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        child_id,
        week_end_date
    FROM data_867
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        child_id,
        week_end_date
    FROM data_867_pap
    WHERE valid_order = 1
      AND qty_sold > 0
),
analysis_weeks AS (
    SELECT week_end_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            week_end_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY week_end_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT week_end_date FROM activity_table)
    ) w
    WHERE rn <= 8
),
weekly_universe AS (
    SELECT
        aw.week_end_date,
        at.child_id
    FROM analysis_weeks aw
    JOIN activity_table at
      ON at.week_end_date <= aw.week_end_date
    GROUP BY
        aw.week_end_date,
        at.child_id
),
dormant_flags AS (
    SELECT
        wu.week_end_date,
        wu.child_id,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(at2.child_id) = 0 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_dormant
    FROM weekly_universe wu
    LEFT JOIN activity_table at2
      ON at2.child_id = wu.child_id
     AND at2.week_end_date BETWEEN DATEADD(WEEK, -7, wu.week_end_date) AND wu.week_end_date
    GROUP BY
        wu.week_end_date,
        wu.child_id
),
weekly_dormant_counts AS (
    SELECT
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, df.week_end_date) AS week_start_date,
        df.week_end_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN df.is_dormant = 1 THEN df.child_id END) AS weekly_dormant_accounts
    FROM dormant_flags df
    GROUP BY
        DATEADD(DAY, -6, df.week_end_date),
        df.week_end_date
)
SELECT
    week_start_date,
    week_end_date,
    weekly_dormant_accounts
FROM weekly_dormant_counts
ORDER BY week_end_date ASC;
